title: The global structure of bi-rotational self-expanders
summary: We describe the self-expanders of the mean curvature flow in $\mathbb{R}^{p+q+2}$ invariant under $O(p+1)\times O(q+1)$. Apart from the Clifford minimal cone, every such hypersurface is complete, proper and noncompact, and belongs to one of three families: two one-parameter families of embedded hypersurfaces diffeomorphic to $\mathbb{R}^{p+1}\times\mathbb{S}^{q}$ or to $\mathbb{R}^{q+1}\times\mathbb{S}^{p}$, whose profile curves leave an axis, and a two-parameter family diffeomorphic to $\mathbb{R}\times\mathbb{S}^{p}\times\mathbb{S}^{q}$, parametrized by the point of the profile curve…
